# Gramlot Examples 0.3.20

Add Python-authored PageStore trial lessons for bidirectional binding, customer loading with status in the Bag, nested iframe/popup publications, cross-page same-owner delivery, and reverse events showing the source PageStore pageId.

Run the trial catalogue with the Python Uvicorn gallery and --websocket. The primary owns one WebSocket and serves its descendants through the Gramlot family protocol. The common catalogue and JavaScript-only environments retain their existing lessons.

Requires Gramlot 0.3.19 and the Uvicorn WebSocket integration in gramlot-py-server 0.3.19 for these trials.
